plan.title: Single-stage forward auction with required T&C acceptance

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable eRFX event creation as required by the case.
Allow the vendor to be added during event creation.
Configure a single-stage auction with a lot-level award.
Use the generated title while satisfying the mandatory title step.
Apply the first available auction pricing template.
Add the requested product with quantity 10.
Set the first row's delivery location.
Complete the remaining required pricing-sheet fields.

args.goal: On the buyer's Terms & Conditions screen, add two clauses, mark exactly one clause as Required and leave the other clause optional, then stop with the configured clauses visible

steps.note: Configure the two event terms, including one required clause; no catalog domain step can add arbitrary clauses.
Confirm the terms configuration is present after the on-screen setup.
Invite one QA vendor for the auction.
Commit the 30-minute schedule.
Publish the configured auction.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Open the invited QA vendor's supplier session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the auction's vendor bid sheet.
Confirm the vendor bid screen exposes the terms section.
Confirm both clause acceptance checkboxes are present.
Accept the first clause checkbox, which is the closest available action for the required clause.
Submit the vendor's bid at 100 after accepting the required clause.
Assert that the vendor bid was submitted successfully.
